$comment: The mnemonics this demo stack hands out for a manual Lace import. DEV ONLY — every one
of them is a public, well-known test phrase and controls value only on a throwaway local
`undeployed` chain. Never use any of them anywhere real.
They are all 'one word repeated + one checksum word' so they can be typed into Lace's
import UI in seconds. Only a handful of final words make a repeated-word mnemonic pass
the BIP-39 checksum; run `derive.mjs --list-repeated abandon` to see the whole set.
The derived addresses live in ../../wallets/wallets.json; `derive.mjs --check` asserts
